senses.gloss: m. (a comp. of טֶרֶךְ a. סִיד) binding cement.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> if one put sand in the lime, <he>הרי זה ט׳ ואסור</he> ed. (ed. Zuck. <he>טרכיו סיד הוא</he>, Var. <he>טַרְכֵי סיד</he>) it is cement and therefore forbidden; <cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:10">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>הרי זה ט׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>טַרְכְּסָאוֹ</he> the binding of it (the lime), cmp. <cite ref="I00904"><he>טְרַקְסִין</he></cite>); <cite ref="Shabbat 80b:7">Sabb. 80ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>תר׳</he>). [<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 8:9">Treat. S’maḥ. VIII</cite> <he>טרכסי׳</he>, in a corrupt passage, prob. to be read: <he>כרכים</he>.]
